The vehicle includes multiple airbags positioned throughout the cabin, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a comprehensive suite of stability systems. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain secure footing on the road.

Practical features enhance daily functionality. Carpeted floor mats protect your interior, while the cargo tray and cargo net organize your belongings. Mud guards protect the vehicles exterior, and a first aid kit ensures preparedness. Speed-sensitive wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions, while delay-off headlights provide convenient illumination as you exit the vehicle.

We invite you to visit and experience how the 2026 Hyundai Sonata SEL Sport can enhance your daily commute and weekend adventures alike.

This 2024 Ford Bronco Sport Big Bend combines capable all-wheel-drive performance with the comfort and connectivity features you expect in a modern SUV.

- Premium Wrapped Steering Wheel
- Wireless Charging Pad
- Heated Front Bucket Seats

The Big Bend trim delivers practical amenities designed for everyday driving and weekend adventures. You'll appreciate the responsive handling enabled by four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering that adjusts to your driving conditions.

Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful design focused on your convenience. Heated front bucket seats with an 8-way power driver's seat let you find your ideal driving position, while the premium wrapped steering wheel provides a quality feel with every drive. The wireless charging pad keeps your device ready, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your attention where it belongs.

Connectivity comes standard through SYNC 3, which integrates your smartphone for calls, messaging, and audio streaming. The AM/FM stereo with SiriusXM satellite radio expands your entertainment options, while six speakers deliver clear sound throughout the cabin. Climate control maintains comfort with automatic temperature adjustment and front heated seats for cooler mornings.

Safety features include dual front and side impact airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control working together to help protect you and your passengers. Rear parking sensors and an electronic parking brake assist with maneuvering, while the security system provides peace of mind when you're away from the vehicle.

The white exterior presents a clean, versatile appearance that suits any setting. With 16,494 miles on the odometer, this Bronco Sport Big Bend remains virtually new with warranty coverage still in place, ready to support miles of reliable service ahead.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this Bronco Sport firsthand and discuss how it fits your lifestyle.

This 2017 Nissan Murano Platinum delivers a refined driving experience with a commanding presence on the road and thoughtful appointments throughout the cabin.

- Pearl White special paint with rear bumper protector
- Platinum Technology Package with Predictive Forward Collision Warning and Forward Emergency Braking
- Power panoramic moonroof for added light and openness

- Heated and cooled front bucket seats with leather-appointed trim
- Navigation system with SiriusXM-integrated audio

The Murano's spacious interior combines comfort with practicality. Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps all passengers comfortable, while the split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs. The heated and cooled front seats offer adjustability through memory settings, ensuring you find your ideal driving position every time. The rear seat center armrest provides additional convenience for passengers on longer drives.

Safety is prioritized throughout this vehicle. The Platinum Technology Package includes forward emergency braking and predictive forward collision warning to help you stay aware of road conditions. Blind spot warning adds another layer of awareness, while the comprehensive airbag system and electronic stability control work together to protect you and your passengers. Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering contribute to confident handling in various driving conditions.

The 3.5L V6 engine paired with CVT transmission delivers a smooth, responsive driving experience. With an EPA rating of 21 city and 28 highway miles per gallon, the all-wheel-drive system provides dependable traction without sacrificing efficiency. You'll appreciate the balance of performance and practicality this powertrain offers.

Inside, entertainment and convenience features enrich every journey. The AM/FM/CD audio system with navigation integrates SiriusXM satellite radio and features 11 speakers for quality sound. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and handsfree Bluetooth allow you to stay connected safely. The overhead console, multiple storage compartments, and illuminated entry enhance usability throughout the cabin.

The exterior design presents a polished appearance with purpose-built features. The panoramic moonroof creates an airy cabin atmosphere, while 20-inch machined aluminum-alloy wheels showcase a premium aesthetic. Fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality and front fog lights improve visibility, completed by a power liftgate for convenient cargo access.

This Murano Platinum stands ready to serve your transportation needs with capability and refinement. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it aligns with your driving requirements.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully appointed cabin that balances sportiness with comfort, featuring premium leather seating surfaces, dual-zone climate control with rear air conditioning, and the premium audio system that transforms every drive into an immersive experience.

Technology integration throughout this vehicle emphasizes driver assistance and connectivity. The Uconnect 5 system provides seamless smartphone integration, while adaptive cruise control and comprehensive collision warning systems work to keep you confident on the road. The heated and ventilated front seats, combined with heated rear seats, ensure comfort in all seasons. Additional conveniences include the power liftgate, automatic headlights, heated mirrors, and the emergency communication system for peace of mind.

This Durango seats seven passengers across three rows with the flexibility of split-folding rear seating, making it practical for both daily driving and family adventures. The combination of premium materials including the suede headliner and carbon fiber accents demonstrates the level of refinement applied to this performance SUV. Every detail, from the Satin Black hood and tail lamp badge to the Supercharged sill plates, reinforces the SRT Hellcat identity.

With 12 MPG city and 17 MPG highway ratings, you'll have realistic expectations for fuel consumption given the performance capabilities. The vehicle is equipped with modern safety features including multiple airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and ABS, all working together to provide comprehensive protection.

This Sierra AT4 combines rugged capability with refined comfort. The 3.0L I6 engine paired with 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD delivers reliable power, while achieving 22 city and 26 highway MPG. The AT4 CarbonPro Edition features a premium carbon fiber composite bed and distinctive hard badge styling that sets it apart. An engine block heater ensures reliable cold-weather starts.

The 15 Head-Up Display keeps vital information at your sight line, while the Rear Camera Mirror and HD Surround Vision provide comprehensive visibility for safety and maneuverability. Automatic temperature control, dual-zone air conditioning, and a heated steering wheel create a welcoming cabin year-round. Inside, you'll find premium appointments throughout with quality materials and thoughtful design.

Safety systems work together to protect you and your passengers. Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Pedestrian Braking, and Rear Cross Traffic Braking provide active protection. Lane Keep Assist monitors lane position, while the Following Distance Indicator helps maintain safe spacing. Ultrasonic front and rear park assist guides you into tight spaces with precision.

Off-road features including off-road suspension, auto-locking rear differential, and hill descent control prepare this truck for rugged terrain. The integrated trailer brake controller and trailering package make towing straightforward and secure. Red recovery hooks offer additional capability when needed.

The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control create a refined driving environment. The 19-speaker audio system delivers concert-quality sound, while the head-up display projects vital information directly into your line of sight.

Safety and convenience are woven throughout this vehicle. The RS Driver Assistance Package includes traffic sign recognition, an adaptive cruise control system that navigates traffic jams, and active lane assist with hands-on detection. The top view camera system and park assist make maneuvering intuitive, while side assist and pre-sense rear technology provide additional awareness.

Navigation is seamless with MMI Navigation Plus and Audi Connect, keeping you connected and informed throughout every journey. The power moonroof opens the cabin to natural light and fresh air.

With 61,701 miles on the odometer, this RS 5 has been responsibly maintained and remains a compelling entry point into the performance luxury segment. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand in our showroom.

Rain-sensing windshield wipers and blind spot monitoring further demonstrate the vehicle s commitment to using intelligent technology to mitigate hazards before they become issues.

A robust suite of packages and premium features adds real-world convenience and luxury to daily drives. The Lariat Ultimate Package bundles upgrades such as heated/ventilated front seats with memory, heated rear seats, and a heated steering wheel for year-round comfort.

description:
This 2019 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ brings together capability, comfort, and dependable power in a vehicle built for serious work and daily driving.

- Duramax 6.6L Turbo-Diesel V8 engine with Allison 1000 6-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD with electronic shift transfer case
- Full-feature leather-appointed heated and vented front bucket seats with 10-way power adjusters
- Chrome heated power-adjustable trailering mirrors with integrated turn signals and auxiliary cargo lamp
- Integrated trailer brake controller with gooseneck and fifth-wheel prep package
- 20" polished aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Spray-on pickup bed liner
- Hill descent control and off-road Z71 package with Rancho shocks and underbody shields
- Chevrolet Infotainment System with 8" color touchscreen navigation
- Remote vehicle starter and keyless entry
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear window defogger
- Front and rear park assist with exterior rear camera

The diesel engine paired with the Allison transmission delivers the torque and reliability needed for towing and hauling, while the 4WD system with electronic shift transfer case provides control in varied terrain. The Z71 off-road package adds twin tube Rancho shocks, hill descent control, and protective underbody shields, enhancing capability in demanding conditions.

Inside, the heated and vented leather front bucket seats with 10-way power adjustment and memory settings create a comfortable workspace for long days. The climate control system maintains temperature zones independently, and the leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls keeps functions within reach. The spray-on bed liner protects your cargo area from daily wear.

The integrated trailer brake controller and gooseneck prep package make this truck ready for serious towing applications. The auxiliary cargo lamp integrated into the trailering mirrors improves visibility when backing with a trailer. Chrome assist steps and 20" polished wheels add a professional appearance.

Technology includes the Chevrolet Infotainment System with navigation, SiriusXM satellite radio, and a color driver information center. OnStar connectivity and a remote vehicle starter give you control and peace of mind. Wireless charging and multiple USB ports keep devices powered throughout your day.

This Silverado 2500HD LTZ combines the diesel power you need with the daily comfort features that matter, backed by the durability Chevrolet trucks are known for.

This 2021 GMC Yukon XL Denali delivers commanding presence and refined capability for those who demand both space and sophistication.

- Denali Premium Package with Advanced Technology Package
- Dual-Pane Panoramic Power Sunroof
- Power-Retractable Assist Steps with Perimeter Lighting
- 22 Bright Machined Aluminum Wheels
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 Engine with 10-Speed Automatic
- Hands-Free Power Programmable Rear Liftgate
- 15 Diagonal Multi-Color Head-Up Display
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Lane Keep Assist
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats with 12-Way Power Adjusters
- Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking with Surround Vision
- Heated Automatic Steering Wheel
- Bose 14-Speaker Surround Sound System
- 3rd Row 60/40 Power-Folding Split-Bench Seat
- Advanced Security Package

The exterior showcases Dark Sky Metallic Blue paint paired with chrome door handles and body-color strips, complemented by galvano bodyside moldings and bright front and rear door sill plates. The 22-inch bright machined aluminum wheels with premium paint distinguish this Yukon XL from standard models, while power-retractable assist steps make entry and exit effortless for all passengers.

Inside, the Denali interior combines comfort with technology. Heated and ventilated driver and front passenger seats with 12-way power adjustment ensure personalized support for long drives. The heated second-row outboard seats and heated third-row seating extend comfort throughout the cabin. An auto-dimming rearview mirror and interior rearview auto-dimming rear camera mirror enhance visibility, while the universal home remote provides convenient garage access.

Safety technology integrates seamlessly throughout this model. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, adaptive cruise control with following distance indicator, rear cross traffic alert, and rear pedestrian alert work together to monitor your surroundings. Lane change alert with side blind zone alert and lane keep assist guide you down the road with confidence. The vehicle inclination sensor and hill descent control provide additional assurance in varying terrain.

Entertainment and navigation features keep you connected and informed. The navigation system works with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, while the Bose 14-speaker surround sound system delivers superior audio quality. SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio and HD Radio keep you entertained throughout your journey. The dual-pane panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light and fresh air.

With the EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine producing 14 city and 19 highway MPG, this 4WD Yukon XL balances performance with practical efficiency. The 10-speed automatic transmission with overdrive provides smooth acceleration and responsive handling, while magnetic ride control suspension and adaptive suspension work together to deliver a refined ride quality.

This 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTD RST is a capable work truck and weekend companion built for those who demand both performance and dependability.

- Z71 Off-Road and Protection Package with off-road suspension and hill descent control
- 265/65R18 all-terrain tires with white outlined letters
- EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- SiriusXM satellite radio with AM/FM
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with heated steering wheel
- Heated driver and front outboard passenger seats
- EZ Lift power lock and release tailgate with rear vision camera
- Chevytec spray-on black bedliner with bed protection package
- LED cargo area lighting and front LED fog lamps
- 40/20/40 front split-bench seat with 10-way power driver seat
- Remote vehicle starter system with keyless open and start
- Power windows, locks, and mirrors with automatic headlights
- Trailering package with hitch guidance and front recovery hooks
- 18-inch bright silver painted aluminum wheels

The RST trim delivers refined styling with body-color bumpers, grille, and mirror caps finished in high gloss black. The dual exhaust exits through polished outlets, while LED fog lamps and automatic headlights enhance both appearance and visibility. Inside, a leather-wrapped steering wheel and cloth seat trim create a comfortable driving environment with multiple storage options including overhead console and door bins.

Capable and well-equipped, this Silverado handles demanding tasks with confidence. The Z71 off-road suspension combines with hill descent control to provide control in challenging terrain. The Chevrolet MyLink system provides navigation and entertainment through its 8 touchscreen, complemented by the BOSE audio system and SiriusXM capability.

Practicality meets technology with features like the integrated trailer brake controller, which simplifies towing management. The ultrasonic park assist system combined with the rear vision camera makes parking and maneuvering easier, while the engine block heater and exhaust brake enhance cold-weather capability and towing control. The trailering provisions accommodate fifth wheel and gooseneck configurations, expanding your towing options.

This Silverado 2500HD LTZ represents a mature, well-equipped truck ready for work or weekend adventures. With its proven diesel engine, comprehensive comfort amenities, and aggressive styling, it stands ready to serve your needs with reliability and capability.

The Infotainment 3 system with its expansive 11.3" display puts connectivity at your fingertips, complete with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility for seamless smartphone integration.

The HD Surround Vision system provides enhanced visibility from multiple angles, while Traffic Sign Recognition helps keep you aware of road conditions. OnStar and Chevrolet Connected Services offer emergency support and vehicle management capabilities.

Style and refinement come together with the sleek black exterior, body-color bumpers, and 19" carbon flash metallic aluminum wheels. The power dual glass panoramic sliding sunroof floods the cabin with natural light and opens up your driving experience. Rain-sensing wipers and automatic high-beam headlights with front fog lamps ensure visibility in all conditions.

The Equinox RS In-Transit comes equipped with practical features that support your lifestyle. The power liftgate makes loading and unloading cargo effortless, while the split-folding rear seat provides flexible cargo configurations for larger items. Heated rear outboard seating positions extend comfort to all passengers, and the rear camera mirror washer keeps your visibility crystal clear.

Performance-tuned shock absorbers front and rear ensure this heavy-duty truck handles with confidence whether navigating city streets or tackling rough terrain.

The 6.4L Hemi V8 engine paired with the 6-speed automatic transmission delivers the power you need for towing and hauling, while the multi-displacement system helps manage fuel consumption. Four-wheel drive capability and the Off Road Package features including hill descent control and transfer case skid plate protection mean you're ready for challenging conditions whenever they arise.

Inside, leather-trimmed sport bucket seats with integrated heating welcome you to a truck designed for both work and refined daily driving. The heated steering wheel, dual zone climate control, and premium interior trim panels reflect the Laramie level of luxury. Integrated Bluetooth, voice command, and the Uconnect touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keep you connected to what matters most.

This Ram 2500 combines the capability you need with the comfort and technology you deserve. The spray-in bedliner protects your cargo investment, while the tubular side steps add practical functionality to the truck's commanding stance. With 89,558 miles, this truck represents solid value for buyers seeking authentic heavy-duty performance and proven durability.

Your heavy-duty truck ownership begins with a visit to our showroom, where we're ready to put you behind the wheel of this impressive Ram 2500 Laramie Mega Cab 4X4.

description: If you've been searching for one of the nicest Hummer H2s on the market, your search may be over. Mashburn Motors is proud to offer this exceptional 2005 Hummer H2 Lux Series showing just 13,637 original miles and backed by a perfect, accident-free Carfax. This Hummer has spent its entire life in North Carolina and Alabama, helping preserve its outstanding condition, and it is one of the finest original examples we've had the opportunity to offer. This is a preserved H2not a restored oneand that distinction is evident the moment you see it. Finished in beautiful Black over a Black leather interior, this H2 has tremendous eye appeal. The paint retains a deep, mirror-like shine, the body is exceptionally straight, and the factory chrome wheels, dealer-installed chrome brush guard, chrome tubular assist steps, and chrome exterior trim give it the commanding presence that made the H2 an American icon. The BFGoodrich All-Terrain tires appear to be the original factory tires, a testament to how carefully this Hummer has been driven and maintained throughout its life. Powered by the legendary 6.0-liter Vortec V8 and backed by a smooth-shifting automatic transmission and full-time four-wheel drive, this Hummer starts instantly, runs beautifully, and drives exactly like a vehicle with only 13,637 original miles should. The engine compartment remains exceptionally clean and original, while the underside is equally impressive, showing the kind of preservation that enthusiasts hope to find on a southern-owned, low-mileage vehicle. The Lux Series came loaded with premium equipment, including heated leather seating, memory driver's seat, power sliding sunroof, Bose premium audio system, six-disc CD changer, third-row seating, automatic climate control, power windows, power locks, power mirrors, roof crossbars, chrome appearance package, and much more. The black leather interior remains beautifully preserved with only the slightest signs of use, while the carpets, dashboard, steering wheel, and trim all reflect the careful ownership this Hummer has enjoyed since new. Just as impressive is the documentation that accompanies this H2. It comes complete with the original window sticker showing an MSRP of nearly $58,000, the original owner's manuals, factory portfolio, multiple factory keys, and keyless entry remotes. It's rare to find a vehicle of this age with all that. Finding a Hummer H2 isn't difficult. Finding one with 13,637 original miles, a perfect accident-free Carfax, southern ownership from North Carolina and Alabama, complete documentation, and this level of preservation is another story entirely. If you've been waiting for an H2 that hasn't been abused, heavily modified, or driven into the ground, this beautiful Lux Series deserves a place at the very top of your list. description:
The 2027 Chevrolet Equinox RS offers an exceptional driving experience with its dynamic performance and premium features. Meticulously designed to elevate your daily commute, this Equinox RS delivers a compelling blend of style, capability, and technology.

- LPO, FLOOR LINER PACKAGE
- Preferred Equipment Group 2RS
- All-Weather Floor Liners
- Cargo Mat
- Second Row All-Weather Mat

Equipped with a 1.5L I4 engine and 8-speed automatic transmission, the Equinox RS provides a smooth, efficient ride with impressive fuel economy ratings of 25 city/29 highway MPG. Its advanced all-wheel drive system ensures confident handling in a variety of road conditions.

Inside, the Equinox RS pampers you with a wealth of premium amenities, including a heated steering wheel, heated front seats, and a 11.3" diagonal advanced color LCD display with Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto. The spacious cabin offers ample room for passengers and cargo, with a power liftgate for easy access.

Safety is a top priority, with features like automatic high-beam headlights, forward collision alert, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, and a rear vision camera to help you navigate with confidence. OnStar and Chevrolet connected services provide added peace of mind.

Elevate your driving experience with the 2027 Chevrolet Equinox RS. Schedule a test drive today and discover the perfect blend of style, performance, and technology.

description:
This 2022 Acura TLX A-Spec Package delivers refined performance and sophisticated styling, backed by a clean Carfax report that confirms its well-maintained history.

- 2.0L DOHC 10-Speed Automatic engine with Front-Wheel Drive
- Majestic Black Pearl exterior with premium 19 Shark Gray Interwoven alloy wheels
- ELS Studio 3D Premium Audio System with 17 speakers and SiriusXM
- Acura Navigation System with 3D View, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto
- Heated and ventilated front sport seats with premium Milano leather and Ultrasuede trim
- Power moonroof with auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Lane Keeping Assist System and Auto High-beam Headlights
- Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS
- Emergency communication system via AcuraLink
- Dual front and side impact airbags with knee and overhead airbags
- Automatic temperature control with front dual-zone climate management
- Adaptive suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Exterior parking camera with rear view display
- Remote keyless entry with HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel with audio controls

The TLX A-Spec Package combines everyday practicality with athletic capability. The 2.0L DOHC engine delivers a responsive driving experience while maintaining efficiency at 22 city and 30 highway MPG. The sport-tuned suspension and speed-sensing steering create confident handling that makes both daily commutes and weekend drives enjoyable.

Inside, the cabin reflects Acura's commitment to quality. The premium Milano leather and Ultrasuede trimmed interior wraps around front sport seats that offer heated and ventilated settings for year-round comfort. Memory functions for both driver and passenger seats mean your preferences are automatically recalled each time you drive. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during night driving.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily routine. The Acura Navigation System with 3D View provides intuitive route guidance, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto let you access your smartphone's features through the intuitive interface. The ELS Studio 3D Premium Audio System with 17 speakers elevates every drive, whether you're enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio or your personal music library.

Safety is paramount with this A-Spec Package. Lane Keeping Assist System helps maintain your position in the lane, while Auto High-beam Headlights optimize visibility. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front, dual front side, knee, and overhead protection. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work together to maintain grip in challenging conditions, while the four-wheel independent suspension provides a composed ride over varied road surfaces.

At 28,352 miles, this 2022 TLX A-Spec Package remains well within typical usage parameters and demonstrates careful ownership. The combination of Acura's refined engineering, comprehensive safety features, and luxury appointments makes this sedan an excellent choice for discerning drivers who value both performance and sophistication.

- Pro Trailer Backup Assist with integrated trailer brake controller and max towing up to 13,200 lbs
- 3.5L V6 EcoBoost engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD

Automatic high beam headlights work with rain-sensing wipers, while the electronic stability control and traction control help you maintain command on any surface. The reverse sensing system and exterior parking camera provide confidence when maneuvering in tight spaces. Emergency communication through SYNC 3 911 Assist adds another layer of protection.

Off-road capability is built in with the FX4 Off-Road Package, which includes skid plates for the fuel tank, transfer case, and front differential. The off-road tuned front shock absorbers and hill descent control mean this truck is ready for adventure beyond the pavement. The upgraded front stabilizer bar and higher-capacity radiator with higher-power cooling fans ensure reliable performance in demanding conditions.

Convenience features make every drive more enjoyable. Remote start with tailgate release lets you prepare the truck before you step outside, while SYNC Connect provides remote locking, unlocking, and vehicle status checks from your smartphone. The Wi-Fi hotspot connects up to 10 devices and includes a trial subscription. You'll also benefit from keyless entry, keyless start, and universal garage door opener integration.

This F-150 Lariat represents the full package: a capable workhorse with luxury appointments, advanced safety technology, and the proven reliability of Ford's full-size truck platform. Whether you're managing daily commutes, weekend projects, or weekend getaways, this truck delivers the versatility you're looking for. We invite you to experience it firsthand at our dealership.

description:
This 2020 Lincoln Nautilus Reserve in Black delivers sophisticated style and capable performance for the discerning driver who values both comfort and control.

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- All-Wheel Drive for confident traction in varied conditions
- Monochromatic Package with distinctive 20 wheels and unique body-color mesh upper grille
- Premium leather-trimmed heated and cooled bucket seats
- Panoramic Vista Roof for added light and openness
- Voice-Activated Touchscreen Navigation System
- Heated steering wheel and heated door mirrors
- Revel AM/FM/HD Audio System with SiriusXM and 13-speaker configuration
- SYNC 3 Communications and Entertainment System
- Adaptive suspension for composed handling
- Backup camera for added parking confidence
- Automatic high-beam headlights and fog lights
- Bluetooth connectivity for seamless device pairing
- Power liftgate and split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo management
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control

The 2.0L turbocharged engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission provides balanced performance, delivering 20 city and 25 highway mpg. The all-wheel-drive system ensures secure footing on various road surfaces, while the adaptive suspension absorbs road imperfections for a composed driving experience. This mid-size luxury crossover combines refined engineering with practical capability.

Inside, the Reserve trim emphasizes comfort and convenience. Heated and ventilated front seats adjust to your preferences, while the heated steering wheel provides warmth during colder months. The panoramic roof floods the cabin with natural light, and the leather-appointed interior reflects the attention to detail throughout the vehicle.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily driving. The navigation system guides you with precision, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep your smartphone fully connected. The Revel audio system ensures your music sounds exceptional, whether you're streaming or tuning to SiriusXM radio.

Safety features protect what matters most. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and an overhead airbag system work with electronic stability control and traction control. The backup camera assists when reversing, and the 911 Assist emergency communication system provides added peace of mind.

This Nautilus has been dealer-inspected, fully detailed, and recently serviced with an oil change. With 50,616 miles on the odometer, it offers excellent value. An extended warranty is available to provide additional coverage and confidence in your purchase.

Settle into the rich Saddle Brown leather seats and enjoy cozy warmth from the heated front and rear outboard seats along with a heated steering wheel that makes cold mornings something to look forward to.

The panoramic power moonroof fills the cabin with natural light, creating an open and relaxing atmosphere whether you are driving through town or exploring scenic back roads.

Your V6 engine delivers the torque you need for towing and hauling, while the 8-speed automatic transmission handles efficiency across city and highway driving. With 17 city and 24 highway miles per gallon, this Canyon balances power with practical fuel economy for those who work hard and drive smart.

The Bose premium audio system transforms your daily commute, and heated front seats with adjustable lumbar support mean you stay comfortable through every season and long drive.

Safety and utility matter in a truck, and this Canyon delivers on both fronts. Four-wheel disc brakes with electronic stability control provide confident stopping power, while the rear parking camera helps you navigate tight spots and work environments. The trailering package complete with hitch and connector means you're ready to haul what matters, supported by Tow/Haul Mode for optimized performance.

The All Terrain exterior styling commands presence on the road. Finished in Red Quartz Tintcoat with 17-inch alloy wheels, heated power mirrors, and automatic headlights, this truck projects capability without compromise. With approximately 45,000 miles on the odometer, this Canyon remains well within its prime, offering years of dependable service ahead.

When you're ready to see what capable truck ownership truly offers, we invite you to experience this 2020 GMC Canyon All Terrain firsthand. Our team is prepared to walk through every feature and answer your questions. Contact us today to schedule your test drive.

This 2020 Toyota RAV4 XLE Premium delivers the reliability and versatility you need for everyday driving and weekend adventures alike.

- 2.5L 4-Cylinder DOHC Dual VVT-i engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission
- Power moonroof for natural light and open-air comfort
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration for seamless smartphone connectivity
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Power driver seat with multiple adjustment options
- Exterior rear parking camera for confident backing and parking
- Heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators
- 19 multi-spoke super chrome alloy wheels
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 6-speaker audio system
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control for confident handling
- Remote keyless entry with smart key system and push button start
- Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars
- Emergency communication system with Entune Safety Connect
- Comprehensive airbag system including dual front, side, and knee protection

The RAV4 XLE Premium combines practical functionality with refined comfort. The gray exterior presents a sophisticated appearance that complements both urban and outdoor settings. Inside, the cabin features a leather-trimmed three-spoke steering wheel, leather shift knob, and SofTex seat trim that balances durability with a premium feel. Dual-zone climate control ensures both driver and passenger comfort, while the power moonroof adds an airy quality to your driving experience.

This vehicle performs efficiently with an estimated 28 miles per gallon in city driving and 35 miles per gallon on the highway. The front wheel drive configuration provides predictable handling, and the four-wheel independent suspension delivers composed ride quality across various road conditions. The electronic stability and traction control systems work together to maintain control during challenging weather or unexpected maneuvers.

Safety remains a core focus of this RAV4's design. The comprehensive airbag protection includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power, while the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed of your tires' condition. The rear parking camera offers added confidence when backing up or navigating tight spaces.

Technology enhances your daily commute with steering wheel-mounted audio controls, allowing you to manage entertainment without taking your hands from the wheel. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility lets you access your phone's navigation, messaging, and music seamlessly through the vehicle's system. The remote keyless entry and push button start provide convenient access and ignition.

The versatile interior includes a power liftgate for easy cargo access, a split-folding rear seat that expands your hauling capacity, and a rear seat center armrest for passenger comfort. The roof rack rails provide attachment points for additional storage solutions. An overhead console, illuminated entry, and front reading lights enhance usability and convenience throughout the cabin.

With 73,520 miles on the odometer, this RAV4 XLE Premium remains well-maintained and ready for its next owner. Its proven Toyota engineering, combined with the practical features and comfortable appointments of the XLE Premium trim, makes it an excellent choice for those seeking a reliable crossover. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the quality and capability this vehicle offers.

description:
This 2016 Ford F-150 Lariat in blue delivers the capability and comfort you expect from a truck built to work and live in. With its 3.5L V6 EcoBoost engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck handles both daily driving and challenging conditions with confidence, achieving 16 city and 22 highway MPG.

- Remote Start System w/Remote Tailgate Release
- Blind Spot Information System (BLIS) with cross-traffic alert
- Voice-Activated Navigation with SiriusXM Traffic and Travel Link
- Heated and cooled leather-trimmed bucket seats with 10-way power adjustment
- Spray-In Bedliner (Pre-Installed)
- Extended Range 36-gallon fuel tank
- Lariat Chrome Appearance Package with chrome grille, door handles, and step bars
- Tailgate Step with Tailgate Lift Assist
- LED Side-Mirror Spotlights with auto-dimming feature
- 110V/400W Outlet for powering tools and equipment
- Power Glass Sideview Mirrors with body-color skull caps
- Chrome 20 wheels
- Rear parking camera
- Dual-zone automatic climate control
- SYNC 3 infotainment system

The Lariat trim provides premium appointments throughout. The heated and cooled leather bucket seats with memory settings ensure your comfort on every drive, while the power-adjustable pedals and telescoping steering wheel let you dial in the perfect driving position. Climate control maintains separate temperatures for driver and passenger, and the heated front seats are ready for cold mornings.

This truck is well-equipped for both work and weekend. The extended range fuel tank reduces fill-ups, while the spray-in bedliner protects your cargo bed from damage. The tailgate lift assist makes loading easier, and the tailgate step provides convenient access. Remote start means you can warm up or cool down the cabin before you even step outside.

Safety and convenience are integrated throughout. BLIS helps you avoid blind spots with cross-traffic alert technology, while the reverse sensing system and rear parking camera assist during low-speed maneuvering. The universal garage door opener integrates seamlessly with your home. Electronic stability control and traction control work continuously to maintain grip and control.

Inside, the cabin reflects the Lariat's upscale positioning. Leather trim, chrome accents, and quality materials create an environment that feels professional and refined. The SYNC 3 system with voice-activated navigation keeps you connected and on course, and SiriusXM satellite radio provides five years of service to keep you entertained throughout your ownership.

This F-150 Lariat represents a solid choice for buyers seeking a capable truck with genuine comfort and features that make ownership rewarding and practical.

This 2016 Lexus GX 460 represents a refined three-row SUV built for those who prioritize capability and comfort in equal measure.

- Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross Traffic Alert
- Auto-Dimming & Power-Folding Exterior Mirrors
- Premium Package with Navigation and 8 touchscreen
- Heated & Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated 2nd Row Outboard Seats
- 3-Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Intuitive Parking Assist with front and rear sonar
- Backup Camera with Exterior Parking Camera
- LED Fog Lamps
- Lexus Enform Remote with mobile app connectivity
- Mahogany Wood & Leather Trimmed Steering Wheel
- Rain Sensing Intermittent Wipers
- 4.6L V8 Engine with 6-Speed Automatic transmission
- 4WD capability
- Triple Beam LED Headlights

The GX 460 comes equipped with a 4.6L V8 DOHC engine paired with a 6-Speed Automatic transmission with Sequential Shift, delivering balanced performance with consistent capability. Four-wheel drive provides traction and control across varied terrain, while the suspension system supports both highway driving and off-road ventures.

Inside, you'll find three rows of seating with split folding capability in the rear, allowing flexible cargo configurations for your lifestyle. The cabin features perforated leather seat trim and genuine mahogany wood accents throughout, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury. Climate control zones let each occupant adjust their comfort independently, while heated and ventilated front seats add functionality during seasonal changes.

Technology integration centers on the Premium Package, which includes an 8-inch high-resolution color LCD touchscreen with voice command, 3D navigation maps, and enhanced Bluetooth connectivity. Lexus Enform Remote functionality allows remote door lock and unlock, pre-conditioning, and vehicle status monitoring through your smartphone. The system also includes Yelp, Pandora, and other destination search integration for seamless trip planning.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and knee airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, Anti-Lock Brakes, traction control, and low tire pressure warnings work together to maintain stability. Blind spot monitoring with rear cross traffic alert adds awareness during lane changes and reversing maneuvers, while the backup camera and Intuitive Parking Assist simplify parking operations.

The exterior wears a silver finish complemented by 18-inch split 6-spoke aluminum alloy wheels, LED fog lamps, and triple beam LED headlights. Auto-dimming power-folding exterior mirrors and rain-sensing wipers contribute to practical convenience, while the roof rack supports additional cargo needs.

This GX 460 delivers three-row seating with genuine comfort features, proven V8 engine performance, and modern technology integration for owners who value substantive capability and refined appointments.

You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. The 2016 Tesla Model S 75D in Deep Blue Metallic is a luxurious, innovative, and all-electric sedan that delivers an exceptional combination of performance, comfort, and advanced technology. Finished in the stunning Deep Blue Metallic exterior, this Model S features sleek body lines, a modern aerodynamic design, LED lighting, and stylish alloy wheels that give it a sophisticated and timeless appearance. Whether you're commuting to work, taking a road trip, or enjoying a night out, the Model S offers a premium driving experience with zero tailpipe emissions.

Inside, the 2016 Model S 75D offers a spacious and refined cabin with seating for up to five passengers. The minimalist interior is designed with high-quality materials and provides generous headroom and legroom for both front and rear passengers. A large rear cargo area and a front trunk, commonly known as the frunk, provide impressive storage space for luggage, groceries, and everyday essentials, making this luxury sedan as practical as it is stylish.

Powered by dual electric motors and Tesla's intelligent all-wheel-drive system, the Model S 75D delivers smooth, instant acceleration and confident handling in a variety of road conditions. The quiet electric powertrain provides a comfortable and responsive driving experience, while regenerative braking helps improve efficiency and extend driving range. Whether driving through city streets or cruising on the highway, the Model S offers outstanding performance and a remarkably smooth ride.

Technology is one of the highlights of the 2016 Tesla Model S. It features a large touchscreen display that controls most of the vehicle's functions, including navigation, media, climate settings, and vehicle information. Additional features include Bluetooth connectivity, premium audio, keyless entry, over-the-air software update capability, and multiple USB ports to help keep you connected and entertained on every drive.

Safety has always been a priority for Tesla, and the Model S is designed with a strong safety structure and a wide range of advanced safety technologies. Depending on equipment, features may include automatic emergency braking, collision warning, parking sensors, a rearview camera, electronic stability control, traction control, and multiple airbags to help provide added confidence behind the wheel.

Overall, the 2016 Tesla Model S 75D in Deep Blue Metallic is an outstanding luxury electric sedan that combines elegant styling, impressive performance, advanced technology, and everyday practicality. With its spacious interior, dual-motor all-wheel drive, smooth electric power, and premium features, this Model S is an excellent choice for drivers looking to experience the benefits of electric driving without sacrificing comfort or performance. Its beautiful Deep Blue Metallic finish completes the package, making it a vehicle you'll enjoy driving for years to come.

description:
The 2025 Honda Accord LX delivers the reliability and performance you expect from Honda, with modern features designed to keep you connected and confident on every drive.

- 1.5T turbocharged engine with excellent fuel economy at 29 city and 37 highway MPG
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow for stress-free highway and city driving
- Lane Keeping Assist System for added safety and peace of mind
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration for seamless smartphone connectivity
- Auto High-beam Headlights with delay-off functionality
- 160-Watt audio system with AM/FM radio and steering wheel controls
- Automatic temperature control air conditioning
- Exterior Parking Camera with rear view display
- Speed-sensing power steering for responsive handling
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars
- Dual front impact airbags and comprehensive side impact protection
- 17-inch blade silver alloy wheels
- HondaLink Assist emergency communication system
- Speed-sensitive wipers and fully automatic headlights

The LX trim balances practical everyday features with the dependability that makes Accords a smart choice for sedan buyers. Remote keyless entry and an illuminated entry system make getting inside convenient, while the compass and trip computer help you navigate your day efficiently. The telescoping and tilt steering wheel, along with front bucket seats with a center armrest, create a comfortable driving environment for both short commutes and longer journeys.

Safety is a priority with this Accord. The four-wheel disc braking system includes ABS technology, and the electronic stability and traction control systems work together to maintain vehicle control. The rear parking camera gives you clear visibility when backing up, and the occupant sensing airbag system provides intelligent protection for all passengers.

Inside, you'll find practical conveniences that enhance your daily experience. Dual vanity mirrors with illumination, front and rear reading lights, and an overhead console with storage keep essentials organized and accessible. The driver door bin and passenger door bin offer additional space for items you need within reach.

The white exterior provides a clean, professional appearance that maintains its appeal through seasons of driving. The combination of modern safety systems, fuel-efficient turbocharged engine, and user-friendly technology creates a vehicle built for today's drivers who value both substance and smart features.

This 2025 Accord LX is ready to serve your transportation needs with the quality and integrity Honda owners trust. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience it firsthand.

The rear backup camera gives you confidence when reversing, while LED front fog and driving lamps enhance nighttime visibility. Dual front impact airbags, side-impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive protection for your occupants.

The exterior reflects the durability you expect from Toyota. White paint is complemented by machined-face 19-inch alloy wheels, black roof rails, and practical roof rack cross bars for your gear. The rear bumper protector shields against minor impacts during everyday use, while LED front fog and driving lamps combine safety with modern styling.

This Highlander SE is ready to meet your family's needs whether that means weekend adventures, daily commuting, or simple everyday dependability. We invite you to come experience this capable three-row crossover firsthand and discover how it fits seamlessly into your life.

This 2026 Kia K4 LXS delivers practical sedan performance with a focus on reliability and everyday convenience.

- 2.0L I4 engine with CVT transmission
- 12.3" touchscreen audio display
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto compatibility
- SiriusXM satellite radio
- Automatic headlights with delay-off function
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Brake assist system
- Dual front and side impact airbags
- 911 Connect emergency communication
- Remote keyless entry
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Heated power door mirrors
- Split folding rear seat
- 16" dark gray alloy wheels
- Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS

The K4 LXS pairs fuel efficiency with straightforward driving dynamics. Its 2.0L four-cylinder engine returns 29 miles per gallon in city driving and 39 on the highway, balancing capability with reasonable fuel costs. The continuously variable transmission provides smooth acceleration without the complexity of traditional gearboxes. You'll appreciate the responsive steering and independent front suspension tuned for daily commutes and weekend drives.

Inside, the cabin offers comfort without unnecessary complexity. The cloth seating accommodates five passengers with front bucket seats and a split-folding rear seat that maximizes flexibility for cargo and passengers. Climate control keeps the cabin comfortable year-round, while the rear window defroster clears visibility quickly. The tilt and telescoping steering wheel adjusts to your preferred position, and front reading lights make it easy to manage details during early morning or evening drives.

Technology and connectivity are handled efficiently through the 12.3-inch touchscreen interface. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps you connected to your smartphone's navigation, music, and communication apps. The audio system includes six speakers, AM/FM radio with SiriusXM satellite service, and steering wheel controls that let you manage functions without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety features are comprehensive for this class. The system includes dual front and side impact airbags, an occupant sensing system, and overhead protection. Electronic Stability Control and traction control help maintain grip in challenging conditions, while brake assist technology supports confident stopping. A security system, panic alarm, and 911 Connect emergency communication provide additional peace of mind. Low tire pressure monitoring alerts you to maintenance needs before they become problems.

The exterior presents a clean, professional appearance with body-color bumpers and a set of 16-inch dark gray alloy wheels mounted on the K4. Heated power door mirrors, automatic headlights with delay-off capability, and intermittent wipers adapted to rainfall intensity handle varying weather conditions. This vehicle has been driven 6,408 miles, indicating it's nearly new.

Visit our showroom to drive the 2026 Kia K4 LXS and experience its straightforward approach to reliable transportation. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you find the right vehicle for your needs.

This Sienna delivers the space and functionality that families need for daily commuting and longer journeys. The silver exterior provides a clean, professional appearance, while the 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission offers adequate power for highway driving. Fuel efficiency ratings of 18 city and 25 highway miles per gallon make this a reasonable choice for a vehicle of this size and capability.

Backup camera integration with on-screen guides provides added confidence when reversing and parking.

Comfort and convenience define the cabin experience. Heated front seats adjust to your preference, while the power moonroof provides an open-air option on pleasant days. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains the temperature you prefer, and the third row can be split and folded to accommodate cargo or additional passengers as needed. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading groceries, luggage, or equipment.

Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system. The rear camera system with sonar alerts you to obstacles behind the vehicle, while the front fog lights improve visibility in challenging weather conditions.

This CR-V EX stands ready to serve as your dependable daily driver. Premium wheels and a rear window wiper add functional touches, while the speed-sensing wipers and delay-off headlights round out the thoughtful engineering. This 2011 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LT represents a capable heavy-duty truck built for serious work and towing demands.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 397 hp and 765 lb-ft of torque
- Allison 1000 6-Speed Automatic transmission with tow/haul mode
- 4WD with electronic shift transfer case
- Heavy-duty automatic locking rear differential
- Off-Road Suspension Package with 35mm twin-tube shock absorbers and skid plate
- Interior Plus Package with power seat, Bluetooth, and USB connectivity
- 18" forged polished aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Heavy-duty trailering equipment with integrated trailer brake controller
- Auto-dimming inside rearview mirror
- Heated power-adjustable outside mirrors
- Engine block heater for cold-weather reliability
- Front fog lamps and fully automatic headlights
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls

The heart of this Silverado is its Duramax turbodiesel engine, known for strong performance and efficiency in demanding conditions. The Allison 1000 automatic transmission pairs seamlessly with the engine, offering six speeds and electronic grade braking for controlled descents and towing stability. The 4WD system with electronic shift transfer case provides flexibility for both highway driving and challenging terrain.

This truck comes equipped with the Off-Road Suspension Package, featuring 35mm deflective disk twin-tube shock absorbers and a skid plate package that protects vital undercarriage components. The heavy-duty automatic locking rear differential enhances traction when you need it most, making this truck a reliable choice for work sites and trail conditions.

The Interior Plus Package rounds out the cabin with practical comfort features. You'll find a six-way power driver seat, AM/FM stereo with CD player and MP3 playback, USB port, and Bluetooth connectivity for phone calls. Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps occupants comfortable year-round, while the leather-wrapped steering wheel with mounted audio controls provides convenient operation.

For towing and trailering, this Silverado is purpose-built. Heavy-duty trailering equipment includes a 2.5-inch receiver with 2-inch adapter, integrated trailer brake controller, and wiring provisions for camper, fifth-wheel, and gooseneck trailers. The bedrail protectors and EZ-lift tailgate add practical functionality to the truck bed.

Additional features include heated power-adjustable outside mirrors with integrated turn signals, an engine block heater for winter starts, and an auto-dimming inside rearview mirror. Chrome bumpers, fully automatic headlights, and front fog lamps contribute to both safety and styling.

The M Sport Professional Package elevates the driving dynamics with distinctive M Sport Brakes featuring Black Calipers and Extended Shadowline Trim, establishing a performance-oriented aesthetic throughout.

The cabin prioritizes occupant comfort through multiple integrated systems. The Executive Package includes Heated & Cooled Cup Holders and Front Massaging Seats, while the Climate Comfort Package delivers 5-Zone Automatic Climate Control with Front and Rear Heated Seats and Front Ventilated Seats. The Panoramic Sky Lounge LED Roof floods the interior with natural light and creates an open, airy atmosphere.

Technology integration centers on the Live Cockpit Pro system, enhanced by ConnectedDrive Services, BMW TeleServices, and a Personal ESIM 5G connection. The Bowers & Wilkins Diamond Surround Sound System ensures audio quality matches the vehicle's premium positioning. Gesture Control and wireless device charging provide modern convenience, while the heads-up display and gesture controls streamline driver interaction with onboard systems.

Safety and convenience features include the Driving Assistance Professional Package, which encompasses Active Driving Assistant Pro, Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Traffic Jam Assistant, and Highway Assistant. This comprehensive suite supports confident driving across varied conditions. Lane Keeping Assistant and Auto High-Beam Headlights add layers of protective technology, while BMW Assist eCall provides emergency communication connectivity.

The interior offers seating flexibility with split-bench third-row seating and a reclining third-row seat, accommodating up to seven passengers. Extended Merino Leather Upholstery, genuine wood accents on the dashboard, console, and door panels, and power-adjustable front seats with memory presets establish an environment of refined comfort suitable for long journeys or daily driving.
